triggers.name: Deploy non-production branches
triggers.deploy_command: npx wrangler versions upload --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env production --var "RELEASE_GIT_SHA:${WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA:?Missing Workers Builds commit SHA}"

triggers.name: Deploy default branch
triggers.deploy_command: npx wrangler deploy --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env production --var "RELEASE_GIT_SHA:${WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA:?Missing Workers Builds commit SHA}"
